rationale: Round 0 built and ran correctly with no ICE fallback, so this round raises obfuscation pressure while keeping cost weights moderate for this small, hot numeric workload (5.3KB text, tight compute loops in Compute_Tree/Compute_Lateral/Compute_Branch). SUB gets the highest SecurityGain since instruction substitution is cheap, correct, and effective across arithmetic-heavy code; SPLIT and IGV are boosted as low-cost diversity multipliers that make the flattening and substitution layers harder to correlate. FLA stays high to restructure the large control-flow-dense functions (optimize_node at 1542B, Compute_Tree, Compute_Branch), with RuntimeCost at 0.35 to limit flattening of the innermost compute loops. BCF is increased over a conservative baseline but its Runtime/Size weights (0.45/0.50) cap bogus-path inflation on a binary that is only ~5KB. IBR is raised to break basic-block continuity cheaply. ICALL is kept at moderate SecurityGain with the highest CorrectnessRisk weight (0.35) because indirect-call dispatch on a small program with many small helper functions adds call-graph noise cheaply but is the most likely pass to perturb the recursive tree-traversal patterns; IGV carries moderate risk weight since global-variable indirection must not disturb the shared simulation state across build.c/compute.c.
